info.title: cartwheel/swing-sketch
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "cartwheel/swing-sketch", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

post.summary: Queued-only: this route answers 403 not_enabled for cartwheel/swing-sketch; use POST /v2/models/cartwheel/swing-sketch/requests.

schema.description: Router body of a Cartwheel Swing Sketch text-to-motion. Omit `requestedModel`: the model id selects it and Router fills it.

prompts: a person waves with the right hand

loop.description: Loops the motion. Defaults to false.

prompts.description: Exactly one prompt with at least one non-space character.

requestedModel.description: Omit it or send null when using Comfy Router; the model id selects `swing_sketch`.

duration.description: Motion length in whole seconds, 3 to 8.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for Cartwheel motions: the completed `GET /proxy/cartwheel/motions/{batchID}` document, forwarded unchanged. Each motion carries one export per actor in `exportURLs`. The URLs are Cartwheel's and expire after one hour; poll again for fresh ones.

items.title: a person waves with the right hand

CartwheelExportSettings.description: Export format of the generated motion.

characterID.description: Character the motion is exported on, for example `char-upload-MHR`.

frameRate.description: Export frame rate, for example 24, 30, 60 or 120.

includeMesh.description: Includes the character mesh in the export.

restPose.description: Prepends the rest pose as frame 0. Defaults to true.

CartwheelMotion.description: One generated motion with its actor exports.

cameraFbxURL.description: Captured camera FBX, valid for 1 hour.

durationSeconds.description: Planned Swing Choreo scene length in seconds, for example 7.416667. It can differ from the requested duration.

exportURLs.description: One export per actor, in actor order. Valid for 1 hour.
